package main

// A seeded violation of the identity lint (TestIdentityLintBansDirectEnvReads):
// one finding per line below.

func seeded(leaf runtime.Provider, rt runtimeIdentity, row session.Info) {
	_, _ = leaf.GetMeta("x", "GC_INSTANCE_TOKEN")
	_, _ = leaf.GetMeta("x", "GC_SESSION_ID")
	_, _ = leaf.GetMeta("x", "GC_RUNTIME_EPOCH")
	_, _ = strconv.Atoi(rt.Epoch)
	_, _ = strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(rt.Epoch), 10, 64)
}

// identityEnvKeys passes in the identity reader's file only.
var identityEnvKeys = [...]string{"GC_SESSION_ID"}
